description: AdNexus Diagnostic Engine — 1000+ parameter config for Meta, Google, Amazon ad campaign analysis. Each check evaluates live account data against thresholds and generates actionable insights. Load this file as the fallback engine when Claude API is unavailable.

checks.name: Low CTR — Feed Ads
checks.insight: Feed ad CTR is {value:.2%}, below the 1% benchmark. Likely creative fatigue or poor audience-ad match.
checks.recommendation: Rotate creatives. Test lifestyle vs product shots. Refresh every 2 weeks.

checks.name: Low CTR — Stories
checks.insight: Stories CTR is {value:.2%}, below 0.8% benchmark. Stories require native-feel vertical creative with text overlays.
checks.recommendation: Use 9:16 creative with first-frame hook, no black bars, text on upper third.

checks.name: Low CTR — Reels
checks.insight: Reels CTR is {value:.2%}. Reels demand hook in first 1.5 seconds and native-feel content.
checks.recommendation: Use UGC-style video, hook statement within 1s, no brand watermark in first 3s.

checks.name: High CPM
checks.insight: CPM is ₹{value}, significantly above the ₹150-200 benchmark for Indian D2C brands. Audience is likely oversaturated or too narrow.
checks.recommendation: Broaden audience, exclude recent purchasers, test Advantage+ audiences.

checks.name: Low ROAS
checks.insight: Campaign ROAS is {value:.1f}x over 14 days. At under 2x you are likely losing money after COGS and fulfilment.
checks.recommendation: Pause lowest-performing ad sets. Shift budget to top-3 performing creatives. Review funnel drop-off.

checks.name: High CPC
checks.insight: CPC is ₹{value}, above the ₹30-40 benchmark. High CPC indicates poor CTR or high CPM — usually a creative issue.
checks.recommendation: Improve ad relevance by better matching creative to audience. Test multiple hooks.

checks.name: Low Conversion Rate (Purchase)
checks.insight: Purchase CVR is {value:.2%}, below the 1% D2C benchmark. Traffic is arriving but not converting — landing page or offer mismatch.
checks.recommendation: Audit landing page speed (must be <3s mobile), check offer clarity, add social proof above fold.

checks.name: High Cost Per Lead
checks.insight: Cost per lead is ₹{value}, above the ₹100-150 target for Indian markets. Lead quality or volume may both be suffering.
checks.recommendation: Simplify lead form to 3 fields max. Add incentive (discount/guide). Test instant forms vs landing page.

checks.name: Low Add-to-Cart Rate
checks.insight: Add-to-cart rate is {value:.2%}. Under 2% signals a product-page or offer problem — price, images, or description.
checks.recommendation: Review product page: add 5+ images, video, size guide, reviews above fold. Check mobile UX.

checks.name: High Cost Per Purchase
checks.insight: Cost per purchase is ₹{value}, exceeding the target. At this rate the campaign is likely unprofitable after COGS.
checks.recommendation: Pause and restructure. Focus spend on retargeting (highest intent) and best-performing TOF creatives only.

checks.name: Zero Purchases (7 Days)
checks.insight: Campaign has spent ₹{spend} in 7 days with zero purchases. Budget is being burned with no revenue return.
checks.recommendation: Pause campaign immediately. Check pixel is firing on purchase confirmation page. Review audience targeting.

checks.name: Declining ROAS Trend
checks.insight: ROAS has declined {value:.0%} over 3 consecutive weeks. Creative fatigue or increased competition is eroding performance.
checks.recommendation: Introduce 2-3 fresh creative angles this week. Increase retargeting budget ratio. Test new audiences.

checks.name: High Frequency — Fatigue Risk
checks.insight: Frequency is {value:.1f}x — same person sees your ad {value:.0f} times/week. CTR is likely dropping and CPM rising.
checks.recommendation: Upload 2 new creative variants. Exclude people who saw ad 5+ times. Broaden audience by 20%.

checks.name: Severe Creative Fatigue
checks.insight: Frequency has hit {value:.1f}x. Audience is severely oversaturated. This is actively burning budget and damaging brand perception.
checks.recommendation: Pause this ad set. Create fresh creative with new angle/format. Expand or change audience before resuming.

checks.name: CTR Declining with Rising Frequency
checks.insight: CTR dropped {ctr_change:.0%} while frequency rose {freq_change:.0%} over 14 days — classic creative fatigue signal.
checks.recommendation: Immediate creative refresh needed. Pause lowest CTR ads, keep top performer, add 3 new creatives.

checks.name: Single Creative Per Ad Set
checks.insight: Only 1 active ad in this ad set. Meta cannot optimize delivery or rotate creatives. Fatigue will hit faster.
checks.recommendation: Add 3-5 creative variants per ad set. Test different hooks, formats (image/video/carousel), and CTAs.

checks.name: No Video in Creative Mix
checks.insight: Campaign has no video ads. Video drives 2-3x higher engagement and lower CPMs on Meta in most categories.
checks.recommendation: Add at least one 15-30s video ad. Even a slideshow or product demo outperforms static in most placements.

checks.name: Low Video Play Rate
checks.insight: Only {value:.0%} of people play your video ad. First frame is not stopping the scroll — likely static or weak visual hook.
checks.recommendation: Redesign first frame: bright colors, motion, or bold text overlay. Test thumbnail variants.

checks.name: Low Video Completion Rate (25%)
checks.insight: Only {value:.0%} watch past the first 25% of your video. Hook is working but viewer drops off immediately after.
checks.recommendation: Deliver value promise in first 3 seconds. Cut any slow introductions or brand logo openers.

checks.name: Low Video Completion Rate (75%)
checks.insight: {value:.0%} watch 75% of your video. Low completion reduces Meta's willingness to show your ad to high-intent users.
checks.recommendation: Trim video to under 30 seconds. Place CTA at 60-70% mark. Add captions for silent viewing.

checks.name: Audience Too Small
checks.insight: Potential reach is only {value:,} people. Meta cannot optimize delivery in a pool this small — CPM spikes and frequency rises fast.
checks.recommendation: Broaden audience by removing restrictive AND conditions, widening age range, or adding broader interests.

checks.name: Audience Too Broad
checks.insight: Audience is {value:,} — extremely broad. Without any narrowing, budget will spread thin and CPAs will be poor.
checks.recommendation: Add 2-3 interest layers OR use Advantage+ Audiences with Advantage+ catalog (for ecommerce).

checks.name: High Audience Overlap Between Ad Sets
checks.insight: {value:.0%} audience overlap between ad sets detected. Ad sets are competing in auction against each other, raising your own CPMs.
checks.recommendation: Use audience subtraction (exclude audiences already targeted in other ad sets). Or consolidate into one ad set.

checks.name: Lookalike Source Too Small
checks.insight: Lookalike source has only {value} people. Meta needs 1,000+ quality signals to build an accurate lookalike model.
checks.recommendation: Use Purchase event as source (not Add to Cart). Wait until you have 1,000+ purchases before creating LALs.

checks.name: No Retargeting Campaign
checks.insight: No retargeting campaign is active. Website visitors and video viewers with high purchase intent are leaving without a follow-up.
checks.recommendation: Create a retargeting campaign targeting: website visitors (30d), video viewers (75%, 30d), add-to-cart (14d), view content (7d).

checks.name: Retargeting Window Too Broad
checks.insight: Retargeting window is {value} days. Showing ads to people who visited 90+ days ago wastes budget on cold visitors who have likely decided.
checks.recommendation: Use 7d for highest-intent (ATC, ViewContent). Use 30d for general visitors. Use 90d only for video viewers.

checks.name: No Exclusions on Prospecting
checks.insight: Prospecting campaigns have no exclusions for existing customers or recent purchasers, wasting spend on converted users.
checks.recommendation: Exclude: Customer list, Website purchasers (180d), Email subscribers. This improves efficiency 15-25%.

checks.name: No Broad/Interest Test Running
checks.insight: No broad or interest-based test campaign is running. Advantage+ audiences often outperform manual targeting in 2024-2026.
checks.recommendation: Run a separate Advantage+ Shopping Campaign or broad targeting test with same creative to benchmark.

checks.name: Budget Exhausting Early
checks.insight: Daily budget exhausts at {value}:00 on average. You are missing peak purchase hours (7pm-10pm) every day.
checks.recommendation: Increase daily budget 30-40%, OR enable Campaign Budget Optimization with ad schedule to concentrate on peak hours.

checks.name: Budget Too Low for Campaign Objective
checks.insight: Daily budget ({budget}) is less than 5x your target CPA ({target_cpa}). Meta needs minimum 5x CPA in daily budget to exit learning phase.
checks.recommendation: Increase budget to at least 5x your target CPA. For ₹500 CPA target, minimum daily budget = ₹2,500.

checks.name: Campaign Stuck in Learning Phase
checks.insight: Campaign has been in Learning Phase for {days} days. Meta cannot optimize delivery properly — performance will be erratic.
checks.recommendation: Stop editing campaigns — every change resets learning. Consolidate ad sets (aim for 50+ conversions/ad set/week).

checks.name: Too Many Ad Sets Splitting Budget
checks.insight: {value} active ad sets competing for budget means each gets too little to learn. This fragments signal and slows optimization.
checks.recommendation: Consolidate to 3-5 ad sets per campaign. Use CBO (Campaign Budget Optimization) to let Meta allocate efficiently.

checks.name: Underspending vs Budget
checks.insight: Campaign is only spending {value:.0%} of daily budget on average. Bid may be too low or audience too small to clear auction.
checks.recommendation: Raise bid cap, broaden audience, or switch to Lowest Cost bidding to improve auction competitiveness.

checks.name: No TOF/MOF/BOF Funnel Separation
checks.insight: Account lacks separate Top/Middle/Bottom of funnel campaigns. Without funnel separation, budget is misallocated and attribution is murky.
checks.recommendation: Create 3 campaign types: TOF (Awareness/Traffic — cold audiences), MOF (Engagement/Video Views), BOF (Conversions — warm retargeting).

checks.name: Pixel Not Firing on Key Pages
checks.insight: Meta Pixel has not fired in {days} days. All campaign optimization is running blind — no conversion data, no audience building.
checks.recommendation: Verify pixel code is on every page. Use Meta Pixel Helper Chrome extension. Re-install via GTM if needed.

checks.name: Purchase Event Not Configured
checks.insight: No Purchase event is firing. Conversion campaigns have no signal to optimize towards — Meta is flying blind.
checks.recommendation: Add fbq('track','Purchase',{value:0,currency:'INR'}) on your order confirmation page. Verify in Meta Events Manager.

checks.name: Duplicate Pixel Events
checks.insight: {value:.0%} of pixel events are duplicates. Inflated conversion counts cause Meta to over-optimize and waste budget on duplicate signals.
checks.recommendation: Implement deduplication using event_id parameter. Remove redundant pixel installations (partner + direct).

checks.name: Low Event Match Quality
checks.insight: Event Match Quality is {value}/10. Low score means Meta can't match conversions to the right users — wasting retargeting budget.
checks.recommendation: Send hashed email, phone, first name, last name with every event. Implement Conversions API alongside pixel.

checks.name: No Conversions API
checks.insight: Conversions API is not configured. iOS 14.5+ and cookie restrictions mean browser pixel alone is missing 20-40% of conversions.
checks.recommendation: Implement CAPI via Shopify Meta Sales Channel, or server-side via Segment/GTM Server-Side. Priority for iOS traffic.

checks.name: Attribution Window Too Short
checks.insight: 1-day click attribution window is active. Many D2C purchases happen 3-7 days after first click — you're undercounting ROAS.
checks.recommendation: Switch to 7-day click + 1-day view attribution to capture true purchase cycle.

checks.name: Missing UTM Parameters
checks.insight: Only {value:.0%} of ad URLs have UTM parameters. Without UTMs, Google Analytics cannot attribute traffic to specific campaigns.
checks.recommendation: Add UTM params to all ads: utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign={{campaign.name}}

checks.name: Too Many Active Campaigns
checks.insight: {value} active campaigns detected. Managing this many reduces focus and makes it hard to identify what's working.
checks.recommendation: Audit and pause campaigns with <1x ROAS. Consolidate to max 10 active campaigns with clear objectives.

checks.name: Campaign Objective Mismatch
checks.insight: Campaign objective is {objective} but destination is a product page expecting purchases. Meta will optimize for wrong action.
checks.recommendation: Use 'Sales' objective for purchase conversions. 'Traffic' and 'Awareness' objectives underpay for high-intent signals.

checks.name: Inconsistent Naming Convention
checks.insight: Less than {value:.0%} of campaigns follow a consistent naming pattern. This makes filtering, reporting, and scaling harder.
checks.recommendation: Adopt: [Platform]-[Objective]-[Audience]-[Creative]-[Date] convention. Rename retroactively in bulk.

checks.name: No A/B Test Running
checks.insight: No A/B test has run in 30+ days. Without controlled testing, performance improvements are guesswork.
checks.recommendation: Run one A/B test per month. Test one variable at a time: audience, creative, or bid strategy.

checks.name: Duplicate Creatives Across Campaigns
checks.insight: {value:.0%} of creatives appear in multiple campaigns. Identical ads compete in auction against each other, raising your CPMs.
checks.recommendation: Use unique creative per campaign type. Dark post creatives if repurposing across objectives.

checks.name: Below Average Ad Quality Ranking
checks.insight: Ad has Below Average Quality Ranking. Meta is penalizing this ad in auction — you pay more for worse placement.
checks.recommendation: Improve creative quality: higher resolution image (1200x1200+), clear product, compelling headline, no excessive text.

checks.name: Below Average Engagement Ranking
checks.insight: Engagement Rate Ranking is Below Average. Users are not reacting to, sharing, or clicking this ad compared to competitors.
checks.recommendation: Add social proof element (reviews, ratings, user count). Use emotional hook in headline.

checks.name: Below Average Conversion Rate Ranking
checks.insight: Conversion Rate Ranking is in the bottom 10% of competitors. Your landing page or offer is losing to competition for the same audience.
checks.recommendation: A/B test landing page offer, headline, and CTA. Ensure page speed <3s. Add trust signals (reviews, secure badge).

checks.name: Low Quality Score Keywords
checks.insight: {count} keywords have Quality Score below 5. Low QS means you pay 2-4x more per click than competitors with better scores.
checks.recommendation: Improve QS by: matching keyword to ad copy exactly, creating tightly themed ad groups, improving landing page relevance.

checks.name: Critical Quality Score Keywords
checks.insight: {count} keywords have QS of 1-2. These are severely underperforming — costing up to 400% more than competitors.
checks.recommendation: Pause these keywords immediately. Rebuild their ad groups with exact-match, dedicated ad copy, and a matching landing page.

checks.name: Below Average Expected CTR
checks.insight: Expected CTR is Below Average for {count} keywords. Ads are not compelling enough to earn clicks in the search results page.
checks.recommendation: Add keyword in headline 1. Use ad extensions (sitelinks, callouts). Test different CTAs. Match search intent precisely.

checks.name: Below Average Landing Page Experience
checks.insight: Landing Page Experience is Below Average for {count} keywords. Google penalizes irrelevant or slow landing pages in auction.
checks.recommendation: Ensure keyword appears in page H1 and first paragraph. Speed must be <3s on mobile. Remove interstitial popups.

checks.name: Low Search Impression Share
checks.insight: You're winning only {value:.0%} of eligible auctions. Competitors are capturing the majority of impressions for your target keywords.
checks.recommendation: Increase bids or budget. Improve Quality Score on low-QS keywords. Check if campaign is budget-limited.

checks.name: High Lost IS — Budget
checks.insight: Losing {value:.0%} of eligible impressions due to budget constraints. High-intent searches are going to competitors.
checks.recommendation: Increase daily budget or reduce bids on lowest-performing terms to free budget for high-value keywords.

checks.name: High Lost IS — Rank
checks.insight: Losing {value:.0%} of eligible impressions due to low Ad Rank. Your bid × Quality Score combination is losing to competitors.
checks.recommendation: Improve Quality Score on core keywords (priority over increasing bids). Ensure keywords have QS 7+ before raising bids.

checks.name: Brand Keyword Not Covered
checks.insight: No brand keyword campaign found. Competitors can bid on your brand name and steal high-intent branded searches.
checks.recommendation: Create exact match brand campaign immediately. Brand campaigns typically deliver 5-10x ROAS at lowest CPC.

checks.name: Keyword Cannibalization
checks.insight: {value} keyword conflicts detected — same keyword in multiple ad groups or campaigns, causing internal auction competition.
checks.recommendation: Use shared negative keyword lists. Keep each keyword in exactly one ad group. Consolidate or pause duplicates.

checks.name: Broad Match Without Negatives
checks.insight: Broad match keywords are active without a negative keyword list. This allows irrelevant searches to burn budget.
checks.recommendation: Add campaign-level negative keyword list with at least 50 irrelevant terms. Review search terms weekly and add negatives.

checks.name: High Spend Zero Conversion Keywords
checks.insight: {count} keywords spent ₹{value:,} with zero conversions in 30 days. These are confirmed budget drains.
checks.recommendation: Pause all keywords with >2x target CPA spend and zero conversions. Review search term relevance first.

checks.name: Zero Impression Keywords
checks.insight: {value} keywords have had zero impressions in 30 days. These are likely below minimum bid or have low search volume.
checks.recommendation: Check for 'Below first page bid' status. Either raise bids or remove keywords with very low search volume.

checks.name: No Search Term Harvest Done
checks.insight: Search Terms report has not been reviewed in {value} days. Irrelevant queries are burning budget without adding keywords.
checks.recommendation: Review Search Terms weekly. Add high-performing queries as exact match keywords. Add irrelevant ones as negatives.

checks.name: Duplicate Keywords Across Ad Groups
checks.insight: {value} keywords appear in multiple ad groups within the same campaign. Ad groups compete against each other in auction.
checks.recommendation: Keep each keyword in only one ad group. Use negative keywords to steer queries to the correct ad group.

checks.name: Missing Negative Keyword List
checks.insight: No negative keyword list is applied to this campaign. Irrelevant traffic is guaranteed to inflate costs.
checks.recommendation: Create a shared negative list with brand safety terms, competitor exclusions, and irrelevant category terms.

checks.name: Low Responsive Search Ad Strength
checks.insight: RSA strength is {value}. Poor/Average strength means Google cannot generate enough winning headline combinations.
checks.recommendation: Add 15 unique headlines (avoid repetition). Use keywords in at least 3 headlines. Add 4 unique descriptions.

checks.name: No Responsive Search Ads
checks.insight: No Responsive Search Ads in this ad group. ETAs (Expanded Text Ads) are deprecated — Google no longer serves them in auctions.
checks.recommendation: Create at least 1 RSA per ad group with 15 headlines and 4 descriptions. RSAs are now the primary ad format.

checks.name: Missing Sitelink Extensions
checks.insight: Only {value} sitelinks configured. Sitelinks increase CTR 10-20% by showing more real estate and specific page links.
checks.recommendation: Add minimum 4 sitelinks (e.g. 'Shop Deals', 'About Us', 'Contact', 'New Arrivals') with 2-line descriptions each.

checks.name: Missing Callout Extensions
checks.insight: Fewer than 4 callout extensions. Callouts highlight USPs (Free Shipping, 24/7 Support) and boost CTR without extra cost.
checks.recommendation: Add 6-8 callout extensions: 'Free Shipping', 'No Minimum Order', 'Easy Returns', 'Trusted by 50,000+'.

checks.name: Pinned Headlines Reducing Reach
checks.insight: {value:.0%} of headlines are pinned to fixed positions. Pinning prevents Google from optimizing the best-performing combination.
checks.recommendation: Only pin brand name or legal requirements. Leave all other headlines unpinned to maximize optimization.

checks.name: Insufficient Conversions for Smart Bidding
checks.insight: Only {value} conversions in 30 days. Smart bidding (tCPA/tROAS) requires minimum 30/month to function — currently running with insufficient data.
checks.recommendation: Switch to Maximize Conversions (no target) until you hit 30+/month. Then set tCPA 20% above current CPA.

checks.name: Target ROAS Set Too High
checks.insight: tROAS target ({target}) is {value:.0%} above actual achieved ROAS ({actual}). Google can't hit this target — impressions and spend will be severely throttled.
checks.recommendation: Set tROAS target at most 10-15% above your 30-day average ROAS. Incrementally raise it as performance improves.

checks.name: Campaign in Learning Period Too Long
checks.insight: Campaign has been in bidding learning period for {value} days. Normal is 5-7 days — extended learning indicates insufficient conversion volume.
checks.recommendation: Stop making bid/budget/audience changes. If learning exceeds 14 days, switch to Maximize Conversions and rebuild volume.

checks.name: No Conversion Value Rules
checks.insight: No Conversion Value Rules are set. All conversions are weighted equally — high-LTV customer segments get same bid as one-time buyers.
checks.recommendation: Add value rules for: new customers (+50% value), high-value locations, repeat purchase intent signals.

checks.name: Slow Landing Page — Mobile
checks.insight: Mobile PageSpeed score is {value}/100. Every 1-second delay reduces conversions ~7%. This is costing you money directly.
checks.recommendation: Compress images (WebP), enable browser caching, use CDN, remove render-blocking JS. Target >80 PageSpeed score.

checks.name: Landing Page Returning Errors
checks.insight: {value:.1%} of ad clicks land on error pages (404/500). Budget is being spent on clicks that cannot possibly convert.
checks.recommendation: Audit all landing page URLs in ads immediately. Set up automated URL monitoring. Redirect broken URLs.

checks.name: High Bounce Rate from Ads
checks.insight: Bounce rate from ad traffic is {value:.0%}. Users are leaving immediately — ad promise vs landing page content mismatch.
checks.recommendation: Match landing page headline to ad copy exactly. Ensure offer in ad is visible above fold without scrolling.

checks.name: No Conversion Tracking
checks.insight: No conversion actions configured. Google Ads is running entirely without any performance signal — cannot optimize bidding.
checks.recommendation: Add Google tag to confirmation page. Set up at minimum: Purchase, Lead, or key micro-conversion. Verify with Tag Assistant.

checks.name: Conversion Tag Firing Multiple Times
checks.insight: Conversion tag appears to fire multiple times per transaction. Inflated conversion counts cause bidding algorithms to over-bid.
checks.recommendation: Add deduplication: set conversion counting to 'One' for purchases. Use order ID as transaction ID.

checks.name: Low Shopping ROAS
checks.insight: Shopping campaign ROAS is {value:.1f}x. Below 3x is typically unprofitable for D2C brands after COGS and shipping.
checks.recommendation: Segment products by margin. Bid higher on high-margin products. Exclude or lower bids on loss-making SKUs.

checks.name: Disapproved Products in Shopping Feed
checks.insight: {value:.0%} of products are disapproved in Merchant Center. These products cannot be advertised — lost revenue opportunity.
checks.recommendation: Fix disapprovals in Merchant Center: check product titles, descriptions, images, GTINs, and price matching.

checks.name: Missing GTINs in Feed
checks.insight: Only {value:.0%} of products have GTINs. Missing GTINs reduce product matching accuracy and Shopping ad eligibility.
checks.recommendation: Add GTIN/MPN to all products in your feed. GTINs are required for branded products and improve auction matching.

checks.name: No Negative Keywords on Shopping
checks.insight: Shopping campaigns have no negative keywords. All irrelevant search queries are triggering product ads and burning budget.
checks.recommendation: Add brand, competitor, and category negative keyword list to all Shopping campaigns immediately.

checks.name: High ACOS — Sponsored Products
checks.insight: ACOS is {value:.0%} — spending {value:.0%} of revenue on ads. Above 30% ACOS is typically unprofitable for most categories.
checks.recommendation: Lower bids on high-ACOS keywords by 20-30%. Pause search terms with >2x target ACOS and zero recent conversions.

checks.name: Critical ACOS — Burning Money
checks.insight: ACOS is {value:.0%} — spending 80%+ of revenue on ads. This campaign is actively destroying margin.
checks.recommendation: Pause campaign. Audit keyword bids (reduce all by 50%). Remove broad match. Restart with exact match only at lower bids.

checks.name: Low ROAS — Sponsored Products
checks.insight: SP ROAS is {value:.1f}x. At this level you earn ₹{value:.0f} for every ₹1 spent — likely below breakeven after category margins.
checks.recommendation: Identify top-converting ASINs and shift budget to them. Reduce bids on non-converting placements.

checks.name: Zero Sales from Campaign
checks.insight: ₹{spend:,} spent in 14 days with zero attributed orders. Campaign is getting clicks but none are converting.
checks.recommendation: Check ASIN listing quality (images, bullets, reviews). Verify pricing vs competitors. Review keyword relevance.

checks.name: Low CTR — Sponsored Products
checks.insight: SP CTR is {value:.2%}, below the 0.3% Amazon benchmark. Ads are appearing but shoppers are not clicking.
checks.recommendation: Improve main product image (white background, high res). Check if price is competitive. Test different headline in SB.

checks.name: High CPC vs Category Average
checks.insight: CPC is {value:.1f}x the category average. Overbidding without proportional conversion rate increase is draining budget.
checks.recommendation: Reduce bids by 15-20% on high-CPC keywords. Use bid-by-placement modifiers to reduce top-of-search overbids.

checks.name: Auto Campaign Without Manual Complement
checks.insight: More than half of budget is in auto campaigns with no exact/phrase manual campaigns. You're missing control over top keywords.
checks.recommendation: Harvest best search terms from auto campaigns (weekly). Add them to exact match manual campaigns with competitive bids.

checks.name: Budget Cap Hit Daily
checks.insight: Campaign budget cap is hit {value:.0%} of days. You're missing peak conversion hours when the budget runs out.
checks.recommendation: Increase daily budget by 30% OR use portfolio budget strategy to distribute across peak/off-peak hours.

checks.name: No Bid Adjustment for Placement
checks.insight: No placement bid adjustments configured. Top of Search typically converts 2-3x better than product pages but gets same bid.
checks.recommendation: Add +50-100% bid for Top of Search. Adjust Product Detail Pages based on ACOS data. Monitor weekly.

checks.name: Declining ROAS — 3 Consecutive Weeks
checks.insight: ROAS has declined for 3 straight weeks. Consistent deterioration signals increasing competition or listing quality issues.
checks.recommendation: Review competitor pricing and review count. Check if new competitors entered the category. Refresh product images.

checks.name: Broad Match Keywords Burning Budget
checks.insight: Broad match keywords have {value:.0%} ACOS. Irrelevant search terms are matching and converting poorly.
checks.recommendation: Reduce broad match bids by 40%. Negate all irrelevant search terms found. Shift budget to exact match performers.

checks.name: No Negatives in Auto Campaign
checks.insight: Auto campaign has no negative keywords. Amazon will match your ads to completely irrelevant searches.
checks.recommendation: Add negative exact match for: competitor brand names, unrelated categories, non-buyer intent terms (e.g., 'how to', 'DIY').

checks.name: Search Terms Not Harvested in 30+ Days
checks.insight: Search Terms report has not been analyzed in {value} days. New converting search terms are not being captured in manual campaigns.
checks.recommendation: Review Search Terms weekly. Any term with >2 orders and ACOS < target should become exact match keyword.

checks.name: High Spend Zero Orders — Keywords
checks.insight: {count} keywords spent ₹{value:,} with zero orders. Confirmed budget drains that need immediate pausing.
checks.recommendation: Pause all keywords with >2x target ACOS spend and zero orders. Review intent match before re-adding.

checks.name: No Brand Keyword Protection
checks.insight: No Sponsored Products campaign targeting your brand name. Competitors can appear on your brand search results.
checks.recommendation: Create exact match brand keyword campaign with maximum bid. Brand campaigns typically deliver <10% ACOS.

checks.name: Competitor Keyword ACOS Too High
checks.insight: Competitor brand keywords have {value:.0%} ACOS. You are overspending for low-intent, hard-to-convert competitor traffic.
checks.recommendation: Reduce competitor keyword bids by 50%. Only run if ACOS is below target. Consider pausing entirely if budget is tight.

checks.name: No Sponsored Brands Campaign
checks.insight: No Sponsored Brands campaigns running. SB ads occupy premium top-of-search placement and drive brand awareness alongside sales.
checks.recommendation: Create at least one Sponsored Brands campaign with headline copy, logo, and 3 top ASINs.

checks.name: No Sponsored Brands Video
checks.insight: No SB Video ads running. Video ads appear mid-search results and have 2-3x higher CTR than standard SB in most categories.
checks.recommendation: Create a 15-30s product demo video in 16:9 format. Feature product in first 3 seconds. No audio dependency.

checks.name: No Sponsored Display Defense Campaign
checks.insight: No Sponsored Display campaign targeting your own product pages. Competitors are advertising on your listings.
checks.recommendation: Create SD campaign targeting your own ASINs. This prevents competitor ads on your product pages for ~5% ACOS.

checks.name: High ACOS on Sponsored Display
checks.insight: Sponsored Display ACOS is {value:.0%}. SD typically has higher ACOS due to lower purchase intent — targeting needs refinement.
checks.recommendation: Narrow SD targeting to: purchaser remarketing (60d) and product detail page targeting on direct competitor ASINs.

checks.name: Advertising ASIN with Low Reviews
checks.insight: ASIN has only {value} reviews. Ads will drive traffic but low social proof will kill conversion rate — wasting ad spend.
checks.recommendation: Pause ads until you reach 15+ reviews. Enroll in Vine program. Focus on organic review building first.

checks.name: Low Star Rating on Advertised ASIN
checks.insight: ASIN has {value} star rating. Shoppers rarely purchase below 4 stars. Ads drive clicks that won't convert.
checks.recommendation: Pause ads immediately. Address product/service issues causing low ratings. Improve product before re-advertising.

checks.name: ASIN Losing Buy Box
checks.insight: Buy Box win rate is {value:.0%}. Ads running while losing buy box direct customers to competitors after click.
checks.recommendation: Pause ads when buy box <80%. Fix buy box by: matching lowest fulfilled price, checking inventory, improving seller metrics.

checks.name: ASIN Out of Stock Events
checks.insight: ASIN went out of stock {value} times in 30 days. Ads running during OOS burn budget with zero possible conversions.
checks.recommendation: Set up inventory alerts at 30 days of cover. Pause campaigns automatically when inventory <7 days. Use FBA for better availability.

checks.name: Missing A+ Content
checks.insight: Advertised ASIN has no A+ Content. A+ content increases conversion rate 3-10% by providing richer product education.
checks.recommendation: Create A+ Content with comparison chart, lifestyle images, ingredient/feature highlights. Available for Brand Registry sellers.

checks.name: High Total ACoS
checks.insight: Total ACoS (ad spend / total revenue including organic) is {value:.0%}. Above 15% means advertising is dominating your P&L.
checks.recommendation: Balance organic ranking investment with paid. Top keywords should rank organically — reduce bids as organic rank improves.

checks.name: Single Campaign for All Products
checks.insight: All products in one or two campaigns. Budget cannot be efficiently allocated between high and low performers.
checks.recommendation: Segment into minimum: Brand Terms, Top-ASIN Exact Match, Category Broad/Auto. Separate by margin tier.

checks.name: No Campaign for New Product Launch
checks.insight: New ASIN detected without dedicated launch campaign. New products need aggressive early bidding to build sales velocity and ranking.
checks.recommendation: Create dedicated launch campaign with 2-3x normal bids for first 30 days. Focus on high-relevance auto + top exact terms.

checks.name: No Active Campaigns — Platform Idle
checks.insight: No active campaigns on {platform}. Platform account is connected but generating zero impressions or revenue.
checks.recommendation: Review paused campaigns. If budget was exhausted, refill and reactivate top performers.

checks.name: Single Platform Only
checks.insight: Only 1 ad platform is active. Single-platform dependency creates risk — algorithm changes or account issues kill all revenue.
checks.recommendation: Expand to at least 2 platforms. If Meta is primary, test Google Shopping. If Google-heavy, test Meta retargeting.

checks.name: No Retargeting on Any Platform
checks.insight: Zero retargeting campaigns across all platforms. Warm website visitors and past engagers are leaving without follow-up.
checks.recommendation: Minimum retargeting setup: Meta Website Custom Audiences (7d/30d), Google Display RLSA, Amazon SD Remarketing.

checks.name: No Conversion Tracking on Any Platform
checks.insight: No conversion tracking configured on any connected platform. All campaigns are running without optimization signal.
checks.recommendation: Prioritize Meta Pixel + Purchase event, Google Tag with Conversion Action, Amazon Attribution Tag.

checks.name: Total Ad Spend Exceeds Revenue
checks.insight: Blended ROAS across all platforms is {value:.1f}x — you are spending more on ads than you earn in revenue. Immediate intervention needed.
checks.recommendation: Pause all campaigns below 1x ROAS immediately. Retain only highest-performing campaigns. Review pricing and offer.

checks.name: Budget Not Diversified Across Platforms
checks.insight: {value:.0%} of total ad budget is on one platform. Platform algorithm changes or account suspensions could halt all revenue instantly.
checks.recommendation: Allocate minimum 15-20% budget to a second platform as a hedge. Build competency across Meta + Google at minimum.

checks.name: MoM ROAS Decline Across All Platforms
checks.insight: Blended ROAS dropped {value:.0%} month-over-month. Cross-platform deterioration suggests a market or product issue, not just ad account.
checks.recommendation: Review: seasonality, competitor promotions, website speed, pricing vs market. Conduct landing page audit.

checks.name: Data Sync Incomplete
checks.insight: Data last synced {value} hours ago. Diagnostic insights may be based on stale data — issues could be worse or resolved.
checks.recommendation: Trigger manual sync from Accounts page. Check API connection health. Re-authenticate if token has expired.

checks.name: Ad Account API Disconnected
checks.insight: {platform} API connection is broken. Adnexus cannot pull fresh data or detect issues on this account.
checks.recommendation: Go to Settings → Integrations and reconnect {platform} account. OAuth tokens expire periodically.

checks.name: Attribution Window Conflict Between Platforms
checks.insight: {value:.0%} of conversions are claimed by multiple platforms simultaneously. Total reported ROAS inflates real performance.
checks.recommendation: Implement third-party attribution (Northbeam, Triple Whale, Rockerbox) for single source of truth on cross-channel attribution.

excellent.label: Excellent
excellent.description: Account is well-optimized. Minor improvements available.

good.label: Good
good.description: Performing above average with a few opportunities.

average.label: Average
average.description: Significant issues present. Address high-severity items.

poor.label: Poor
poor.description: Multiple critical issues. Immediate action needed.

critical.label: Critical
critical.description: Account has severe problems actively wasting spend.

insight_engine.rule_based_description: When Claude API unavailable, evaluate each check in checks[] array against fetched account metrics. Triggered checks become DiagnosticIssue records. Health score is 100 minus weighted sum of triggered check health_score_impact values.
insight_engine.spend_at_risk_calculation: Sum of (check.spend_at_risk_multiplier × ad_set.daily_spend) for all triggered checks
insight_engine.deduplication: One issue per check_id per ad_set/campaign per 24h period
insight_engine.auto_resolve: Issues auto-close if metric improves past threshold_warning for 2 consecutive syncs
